label: Tilt card 3D
desc: A card that tilts in perspective toward the pointer with parallax depth layers, a moving specular glare and a shifting shadow; arrow keys tilt it and touch screens get an idle sway.
use: Feature cards, pricing tiers, product or profile cards on landing pages.

label: Cube carousel
desc: A CSS 3D rotating prism of content faces with title and text; drag or swipe to rotate with snapping, plus buttons, arrow keys and a spoken current face.
use: Feature tours, testimonials, process steps on landing pages.

label: Globe arcs
desc: A dotted 2D-canvas globe with a hand-made land mask and animated arcs with travelling pulses between cities; drag to spin with inertia, arrow keys rotate.
use: Hero or 'global network' section, connect page, dashboard traffic card.

label: Phone 3D
desc: A CSS 3D phone mock-up that follows or is dragged by the pointer, with a screen slot, drawn default app UI, side buttons and a glass reflection; arrow keys rotate, Home resets.
use: App showcase on landing pages, mobile feature sections.

label: Lit torus
desc: A raw WebGL spinning torus with hand-built mesh and matrices, Blinn-Phong shading and a moving light in theme colours; drag to rotate, wheel or keys to zoom.
use: Decorative hero object, loading or empty-state showpiece.
